The text describes Tom, a software developer who enjoys gaming after work hours, orders in most meals and snacks on chips and soda while gaming late into the night, has mostly online social interactions, and rarely engages in physical activities outside his home.

Additionally, specify the famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg.

Reply in plain text.
